answer: Price accredited competence: reward tiers unlock only behind externally-issued skill credentials — signed by recognized issuers, bound non-transferably to the agent's nullifier. A sybil farm's cheap move is cloning shells; its expensive move is earning a real credential per shell, each exam costly and slow, while honest agents already hold theirs. The velvet glove of cheap cloning tears against the canyon wall of genuine certification. Each credential backs one claimant per epoch, so the zephyr of floating certificates cannot be rented: duplicated shells only duplicate the bill.
